title: Steven M. Teutsch Prevention Effectiveness Fellowship
institution: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
field: Public health, health economics, decision science and disease modelling
about: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in the United States accepts applications for the Class of 2027 of the Steven M. Teutsch Prevention Effectiveness Fellowship. Applications, recommendations and unofficial transcripts are due by 11:59 pm ET on 8 January 2027.

upskill.name: Domain-Specific Analytics I
why: Field "Public health, health economics, decision science and disease modelling" → objective "Explore healthcare and clinical analytics applications involving electronic health records, genomics, and epidemiological data."
Field "decision science" → objective "Use domain context to determine appropriate data, methods, evaluation criteria, and interpretations for applied analytics projects."
